definitions.explanation: Dressing up in a costume to look like someone or something else, for entertainment, festivals, or events. Includes Halloween costumes, costume parties, and parade costumes.
Concealing one's true identity or the true nature of something by changing outward appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハロウィン→ハロウィン：27505_harowin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮装|かそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To wear a costume for Halloween.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魔女|まじょ}→魔女：14641_majo⟧やお{化|ば}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮装|かそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The children dressed up as witches and ghosts and walked through town.

examples.japanese: {仮装|かそう}⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{祭|まつ}り→お祭り：01349_omatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目玉|めだま}→目玉：13649_medama⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧だ。
examples.english: The costume parade is the highlight event of the festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮装|かそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}した→侵入する：17343_shinnyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The culprit disguised himself as a security guard and entered the building.

examples.japanese: {密輸品|みつゆひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{貨物|かもつ}→貨物：00165_kamotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮装|かそう}⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The smuggled goods were disguised as regular cargo.

examples.english: It is difficult to see through a disguised enemy spy.

notes: Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form {仮装|かそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dress up in costume, to disguise). Common collocations: {仮装|かそう}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (costume contest), {仮装|かそう}⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧ (costume parade), {仮装|かそう}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧ (costume party). With the growing popularity of Halloween in Japan, {仮装|かそう} has become strongly associated with Halloween costumes. Homophones: ⟦{仮想|かそう}→仮想：17756_kasou⟧ (virtual, hypothetical), ⟦{火葬|かそう}→火葬：13379_kasou⟧ (cremation), ⟦{下層|かそう}→下層：11372_kasou⟧ (lower stratum) — all different words. Related: ⟦コスプレ→コスプレ：07080_kosupure⟧ (cosplay — dressing as specific characters), ⟦{変装|へんそう}→変装：12098_hensou⟧ (disguise — specifically to conceal identity).
